mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing 66 degrees under overcast skies near Harriet Park. We have a Waning Gibbous moon tonight, and while the International Space Station passes overhead, you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The city has released a new batch of engineering service reports, and the Wisconsin Department of Transportation is hosting public meetings on November 18 and 19 regarding the US 18/151 corridor study to gather feedback on new design concepts.

We have a busy schedule ahead. Today you can enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness, ART House 360 Thursday nights, or Hop Haus Trivia. Looking to tomorrow, you can catch live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee, or take the family to the Main Street Trick-Or-Treat.
In a recent report, police assisted with two cardiac arrests on October 21, and on that same day, a woman was arrested for a domestic disturbance at a residence on Church Avenue.
The flavor of the day is the delicious OREO REESE'S Cheesecake. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by and grab a scoop.
